sources.researchNote: The record is of an Australian edition, printed in Sydney by J. Albert & Son rather than imported, and notes the song as from “Mutiny on the Bounty”, a Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer picture. The library also states a copyright position of its own: in copyright until 2053, reasoned as the creator’s date of death of 1983 plus seventy years. That is the same calculation applied to Kaper’s music elsewhere in this collection, reached independently by a national library.
